title.en: An Act Authorizing Provincial Boards to Establish and Manage Irrigation Systems, and Providing Funds for this Purpose.
title.orig: An Act Authorizing Provincial Boards to Establish and Manage Irrigation Systems, and Providing Funds for this Purpose.

text.en:
Subject to the provisions of existing law, the Secretary of Commerce and Communications may
authorize the provincial board of any of the regularly organized provinces to proceed to the construction of an
irrigation system, and in this case the provincial board concerned may, with the approval of the Secretary of
the Interior, appropriate for irrigation purposes any sum not to exceed twenty-five per centum of its road and
bridge fund.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 23, 1918.
